summary_en: 3,514,700 shares (11.4% S/O) acquired for ¥785.9M through 31 July 2026 under a ¥820M, 4,100,000-share (13.33% S/O) program. Execution window 30 Jan–11 Dec 2026. Open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange.
title_en: Notice regarding progress on matters concerning acquisition of treasury stock
translation_en_brief: MBK Co., Ltd. disclosed on 3 August 2026 the cumulative progress of its treasury stock acquisition program authorized by board resolutions of 12 December 2025 and 18 May 2026. The program authorizes the acquisition of up to 4,100,000 shares (13.33% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥820 million through 11 December 2026. As of 31 July 2026, the company has acquired 3,514,700 shares for ¥785.9 million via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. No shares were acquired during July 2026 specifically. The execution window runs from 30 January through 11 December 2026.
